Download **ScreenBox-x.y.z.dmg**, open it, and drag ScreenBox to Applications.
(The `.zip` is the same app, for scripted installs.)

ScreenBox is signed with Orva Studio's Developer ID and notarized by Apple: macOS
asks once whether to open an app from the internet, and there's no security
setting to override or quarantine flag to clear.

Then add it to **System Settings → General → Login Items** to have it start with
your Mac. Press **⌃⌥⌘B** to draw.
